incipit_english: Thus saith the Lord to the Jews: O My people, what have I done unto thee, or wherein have I grieved thee? I gave sight to thy blind, I cleansed thy lepers, I raised up the man that lay upon a bed; O My people, what have I done unto thee, and what hast thou rendered unto Me? For manna, gall; for water, vinegar...
